@Shijir thnx for providing all the details! I was able to create a runnable scenario using stackblitz: https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-ivy-s49yjz?file=src%2Fapp%2Fapp.component.ts - the reason for which you couldn't reproduce it in ng-run is that ng-run was using VE (and this bug is specific to ivy).

Anyway, this is a confirmed bug in ivy - but it seems like a relatively easy one to fix. Marking as a bug. Again, thnx for reporting and providing all the reproduce scenarios!
Hi @pkozlowski-opensource! thanks for the confirmation. Do you think the fix would be merged in before Angular 10 release?

…table nodes

This commit fixes the issue of the ASSERTION ERROR issue when
a projected node(RNode) inside an array is checked against the types
of TNodeType.Element, TNodeType.Container, TNodeType.ElementContainer,
TNodeType.IcuContainer, TNodeType.Projection. As it's inside an array,
it doesn't fall into any of those types, as a result, it throws
the ASSERTION ERROR.

Fixes #37120
